programs.title: Tea with Mussolini
programs.desc: Italian lad Luca, part-raised by English ladies living in Florence in 1935, re-enters their lives just as the encroaching war sees them forcibly relocated.

programs.title: How to Get Ahead at Versailles
programs.desc: Stephen Smith explores the Baroque court of Louis XIV, who created the Palace of Versailles to surround himself with artists, designers, gardeners, chefs and musicians.

programs.title: Art of Scandinavia
